name: Media Vote
overview: Let your users vote on which movies and shows to remove.
description: An administrator calls a vote among selected Jellyfin users. Users vote from a banner at the top of their home page, a Vote tab (Custom Tabs) or a sidebar page (Plugin Pages). At the deadline the top N titles are either reported to the admin (default) or deleted from Jellyfin and disk, with the matching Radarr/Sonarr/Jellyseerr entries unmonitored or excluded so nothing is downloaded again.
